# Leone Daher

> Public portfolio covering mobile engineering, connected systems, AI automation, selected published apps, verified course records, and an article about the LD visual identity. English is the default at the root; Portuguese documents are available under /pt/.

The Markdown versions mirror the public portfolio copy and selected public evidence. Cases describe contribution within teams; store listings are product evidence. The contact section gives the public professional channels.

The 14-app count belongs to the Latitudde/Conkord inventory of Android and iOS deliveries. MAG Venda Digital is excluded; the count does not mean 14 individually authored products.

Case studies describe Leone's role and contribution within teams. A store listing supports the existence of a published product, but does not establish sole authorship or responsibility for the entire product.

Store metrics are snapshots checked in July 2026. Values with + and rounded summaries such as 11.5K+ are not exact counts or current measurements; ratings, downloads, and availability may change.

Certificates document completion of the listed courses. They do not, on their own, establish professional experience, technology mastery, or current language fluency.

The MAG evidence records a collective delivery. The post URL and date are reproduced when present in the selected public record; missing fields remain unknown.

Português: os documentos abaixo reproduzem o conteúdo público do portfólio. Os 14 apps pertencem ao inventário Latitudde/Conkord, sem somar MAG. Métricas de loja foram consultadas em julho de 2026; cursos não substituem experiência profissional.

## English

- [Leone Daher — Software Engineer](https://leonedaher.com/index.md): Mobile products powered by smart, connected systems. Python, agents and automation built around real work.
- [Published apps — Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/apps/index.md): Browse the published mobile products and open each case for screens, stack, and public store proof.
- [Experience by project and contribution. | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/experiencias/index.md): Professional work across companies and clients: from mobile development to service integration, automation, data and infrastructure.
- [Van Cranenbroek — App case study | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/apps/van-cranenbroek/index.md): Offers, catalogues, stores, and customer communication in a multiplatform product.
- [Lyzer Collect — App case study | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/apps/lyzer-collect/index.md): Collection and order preparation built for connected field operations.
- [Lyzer Deliver — App case study | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/apps/lyzer-deliver/index.md): Routes, offline execution, and proof of delivery for field teams.
- [MAG Venda Digital — App case study | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/apps/mag-venda-digital/index.md): A digital sales tool for brokers to follow products and proposals.
- [Lyzer Collect + Deliver — App case study | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/apps/lyzer-collect-deliver/index.md): An operational suite connecting collection, order preparation, routes, and delivery.
- [Certifications — Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/certificacoes/index.md): Browse credentials by year and select one to view the official record and verification options.
- [Visual identity: the LD logo — Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/artigos/identidade-visual/index.md): The process behind the LD symbol, its visual language, and the idea of turning the brand itself into an interface.

## Português

- [Leone Daher — Engenheiro de Software](https://leonedaher.com/pt/index.md): Produtos mobile movidos por sistemas inteligentes e conectados. Python, agentes e automação construídos para o trabalho real.
- [Apps publicados — Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/pt/apps/index.md): Explore os produtos mobile publicados e abra cada case para ver telas, stack e provas públicas nas lojas.
- [Experiências por projeto e contribuição. | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/pt/experiencias/index.md): Trabalho profissional em diferentes empresas e clientes: do desenvolvimento mobile à integração de serviços, automação, dados e infraestrutura.
- [Van Cranenbroek — Case de app | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/pt/apps/van-cranenbroek/index.md): Ofertas, folhetos, lojas e comunicação com clientes em um produto multiplataforma.
- [Lyzer Collect — Case de app | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/pt/apps/lyzer-collect/index.md): Coleta e preparação de pedidos para operações de campo conectadas.
- [Lyzer Deliver — Case de app | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/pt/apps/lyzer-deliver/index.md): Rotas, operação offline e comprovação de entrega para equipes em campo.
- [MAG Venda Digital — Case de app | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/pt/apps/mag-venda-digital/index.md): Ferramenta de venda digital para corretores acompanharem produtos e propostas.
- [Lyzer Collect + Deliver — Case de app | Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/pt/apps/lyzer-collect-deliver/index.md): Suite operacional que conecta coleta, preparação de pedidos, rotas e entrega.
- [Certificações — Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/pt/certificacoes/index.md): Navegue pelas credenciais por ano e selecione uma para ver o registro oficial e as opções de validação.
- [Identidade visual: a logo LD — Leone Daher](https://leonedaher.com/pt/artigos/identidade-visual/index.md): O processo por trás do símbolo LD, da linguagem visual e da ideia de transformar a própria marca em interface.
